At 320 CSS px and 100% text, all four search modes fit in two rows and the query placeholder is visible inside the field.
Desktop real-stack DM keeps the mini-player, screen-share notice in its own row, voice controls, history and composer visible.
Mobile real-stack DM keeps mini-player controls, separate screen-share notice, message history, composer and voice dock in view.
After voluntary leave the status is neutral (“Голосовое подключение завершено.”) and offers join/listen actions without error styling.
Desktop statistics distinguish sender-selected 720p/30 FPS, missing sender confirmation and viewer 640×360 with FPS undefined; no quality claim is implied.
Mobile statistics wrap inside the sheet; close and copy controls remain visible, with selected, confirmation and viewer readings separated.
Narrow DM history content wraps within the message area and the composer send action remains visible.
The 320px DM list scrolls within navigation while the voice dock and profile controls remain reachable.
At 390 CSS px and 200% text, the long candidate name wraps inside the DM starter row; the dialog remains within the viewport and the candidate list continues below its visible scroll area.
At 390 CSS px and 200% text, all four search modes, query, scope, filters and Find action fit the panel; result titles and snippets remain readable and the result list continues below the viewport.
At 1440 CSS px and 200% text, participant cards and the muted voice controls remain within the workspace; the channel label truncates within its rail and the dock actions remain visible.

At 390 CSS px and 200% text, the screen-share diagnostics sheet wraps sender selection, missing confirmation and receiver measurements distinctly; its close control remains visible while technical details continue below the scroll area.
At 390 CSS px and 200% text, the pinned player wraps controls into two rows without covering the DM header, history, two-line draft, send action or voice dock.

At 390 CSS px and 200% text, the member drawer stays bounded; the long first name truncates within its row, presence dots remain attached to avatars, and the full member identity remains available through the row label/title.
The 390px compact header keeps the navigation toggle, truncated channel title, search, member-list and overflow actions on one row.
At 768 CSS px, the DM navigation list occupies its rail and scrolls independently; the voice dock and profile/settings controls remain visible at the bottom.
